issues.description: The battery pack is listed without a defined retention method, protection verification, vent path, or separation from the motor. The factory cannot validate a safe enclosure layout.
issues.fix: Specify pack mounting and insulation, motor-to-pack clearance, vent routing, and protection-circuit verification tests.
issues.rule_citation: Assess battery mechanical protection and abnormal operation — IEC 60335-1; IEC 60335-2-2

issues.description: Shell mating-face and split-line requirements are specified without datums or an assembly tolerance stack. Individual molded parts may pass inspection while the assembled seam fails.
issues.fix: Define assembly datums, measurement locations, and a stack-up covering both shells and their locating features.
issues.rule_citation: Establish a datum system for geometric specifications — ISO 1101

issues.description: The self-tapping screws have a specified pilot diameter, but boss outer diameter, engagement depth, screw grade, and installation torque are missing. Strip-out or boss cracking cannot be assessed.
issues.fix: Dimension the bosses and screw engagement; specify screw grade and installation torque, then validate with torque-to-failure trials.
issues.rule_citation: Design screw bosses for the selected fastener and validate installation torque — Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: The motor, battery, PCB, and charging interface lack defined mounting, connector, and wire-routing details. Assembly access and wire pinch points cannot be reviewed.
issues.fix: Provide an internal layout with mounts, connector orientation, harness paths, strain relief, and assembly sequence.
issues.rule_citation: Protect internal wiring against damage during assembly and use — IEC 60335-1

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 24904 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 127.4 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 160 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Silhouette along +Z, raster 0.6325 mm — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Measured wall 2.20-2.20 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
issues.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
issues.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: 5th percentile of 10760 ray samples into the material (median 2.2 mm)

issues.description: The clear removable dust bin, filter, and housing materials have no stated resistance requirements for cleaning agents or repeated washing.
issues.fix: Specify permitted cleaning methods and chemicals, then qualify exposed materials and finishes against them.
issues.rule_citation: Evaluate material resistance to chemicals encountered in service — UL 746C

issues.description: The PCB outline tolerance is specified, but mounting-hole locations and keepouts are not. The factory cannot check PCB fit against shell bosses or fasteners.
issues.fix: Add PCB mounting-hole dimensions from defined datums, component keepouts, and a PCB-to-housing fit stack.
issues.rule_citation: Specify PCB mechanical dimensions and tolerances for assembly — IPC-2221

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 24904 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 127.4 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 160 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Silhouette along +Z, raster 0.6325 mm — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Measured wall 2.20-2.20 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
issues.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
issues.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: 5th percentile of 10760 ray samples into the material (median 2.2 mm)

issues.description: The shell design specifies self-tapping screws but not boss outer diameters, pilot depth, or rib geometry. The factory cannot check for stripped bosses or cosmetic sink.
issues.fix: Add boss and rib sections, screw engagement depth, and a trial-mold check of the satin faces.
issues.rule_citation: Boss and rib walls should be about 50–60% of nominal wall to limit sink — Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: Individual shell mating-face and boss-pilot tolerances are specified, but there is no assembly datum scheme or stack-up for the split-line step. Inspection may pass individual parts that fail when assembled.
issues.fix: Define shared assembly datums and a stack-up covering shell location, pilots, screws, and the assembled split line; gauge the assembled shells.
issues.rule_citation: Dimensional tolerances must be related to defined datums for functional inspection — ISO 1101

issues.description: The battery pack has protection, but its retention, insulation, wire routing, pinch-point clearance, and separation from the motor's heat are unspecified.
issues.fix: Specify a retained battery compartment, protected cable routing, thermal clearances, and assembly inspection points; validate the complete appliance and pack.
issues.rule_citation: Safety requirements for household electrical appliances and battery systems — IEC 60335-1; safety requirements for portable lithium battery packs — IEC 62133-2

issues.description: The removable dust bin and washable filter have no defined sealing surfaces or gasket specification. Leakage and fit can vary between suppliers.
issues.fix: Define seal material, compression, locating features, and assembled airflow-leak acceptance criteria.
issues.rule_citation: Vacuum-cleaner safety requirements, including construction and testing — IEC 60335-2-2

issues.description: The shells specify flame-rated PC/ABS, but the separate pistol-grip and motor-pod housing has no material or finish specification despite enclosing powered components.
issues.fix: Specify its resin grade, flame rating, finish, wall targets, and supplier material certification.
issues.rule_citation: Material and construction requirements for household electrical appliances — IEC 60335-1
